findings.text: the whole-field declaration is read from the first surviving parsed entry, so a value that opens with the bare declaration word followed by a comma and prose without a parenthetical — `commits: none, no repository change` — loses that word to the parser's none-values emptying and arrives as `['no repository change']`, which is refused with "cites 'no repository change' as a commit"; the hand edit the node set out to remove therefore survives for that shape, and the docstring's claim to read the field across the whole value is stronger than the code.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the base; abd56a80 adds _commits_field_declares_absence and routes both commitless call sites through it plus 313 lines of test, 71ffc727 removes the docs fragment and redraws the decision figure, and 88dcbd4c rewrites the figure with real text elements (1819 lines to 106).
item_verdicts.done_when: the source node's done-when asks for the base reproduction with its refusal text, the review promotion, the implement refusal, a red declared mutation and zero added failures by id; found repro-base.log recording 3 failed / 2 passed on the delivered test file at base source, baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log each reporting zero FAILED or ERROR lines; and negative-control.log showing the declared mutation reddening exactly the comma case while the semicolon case stays green.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a review run whose manifest reads `commits: none` followed by prose promotes through crew complete with no commits and no hand edit while the same prose on an implement run is still refused; found that reckon/crew/promotion.py:1403 gives the whole-field reading to _COMMITLESS_ROLES (reckon/crew/promotion.py:444) and the delivered file's five cases pass in my own arm at the delivered head, but a value opening with the bare word followed by a comma and prose without a parenthetical is still refused (FINDING reckon/crew/promotion.py:479).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits abd56a80, 71ffc727, 88dcbd4c, the separate base arm at 40d23d9b and the declared mutation, and it now names after_suite at 88dcbd4c, which answers the earlier review's finding that the log header named a non-ancestor revision.
